note: After the original description by Snyder (1926) (in English; type series from Rurrenabaque, Bolivia, collected by W. M. Mann in October 1921 (month 10)); the soldier and worker are described, the alate is not. The original text was extracted by OCR from the Internet Archive scan; a few letter forms are wrong (e.g. prefile for profile), and the measurement figures were checked against the context.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head longer and wider than in N. (N.) surinamensis Holmgren, with fewer head setae and a stouter nasus; distinguished from N. (N.) maximus Holmgren by the stouter nasus, which is curved downwards like a hawk's beak, by the dense setae on the abdominal tergites, and by the sparser head setae. Worker belonging to the 'large worker' group (the same group as maximus and surinamensis).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule light chestnut brown, smooth and shining; lateral profile almost straight, only slightly convex at the base of the nasus, with a depression on the vertex; vertex flat, divided on either side of the midline into two swollen cheeks (lateral lobes); lateral margins of the head slightly asymmetrical; long setae in two rows, one on the raised area at the base of the nasus and one near the posterior margin; head capsule broadly pyriform. Mandibles with slender, acute tips. Nasus dark chestnut brown apically, slender, conical and stout, the apex curved downwards like a hawk's beak, covered with long setae. Antennae yellowish brown, 13-segmented, with long setae; segment 3 slender, clavate, longer than 2 and 4; segment 4 longer than 2; segment 5 longer and wider than 4; segments 6—9 longer and wider, subequal in length; segments 10—12 shorter and narrower, subequal in length; terminal segment slender, shorter, suboval. Pronotum yellow, yellowish brown anteriorly, saddle-shaped, anterior margin concave, with long setae. Legs pale yellow, tinged with brown, slender, with long setae. Abdominal tergites yellow, slightly tinged with brown, each with a row of long setae at its base, and with additional shorter, dense long setae on the tergites; cerci distinct, slender. Measurements: soldier total length 4.40—4.65 mm; head with nasus 2.10—2.15 mm; head length (without nasus, to anterior margin) 1.30 mm; nasus length 0.80 mm; pronotum length 0.30 mm; hind tibia length 1.70 mm; head width 1.30—1.45 mm; pronotum width 0.75 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule chestnut brown, T-shaped, with a hyaline spot between the midline and the frontal gland pore. Antennae pale yellowish brown, 14-segmented. Measurements: worker total length 5.50—6.00 mm; head length 2.25 mm; head width 1.80 mm.
